authorization_scope: Implementation and isolated tests only; no production migration, candidate write, review, plan, apply, or main deployment.

implementation.database_shape: The existing nutrition_candidates table and evidence columns are reused; no table or column is added.
component_contract: One present_with_amount row per separately declared citrulline form.
Each row retains declared form, amount, source unit, optional malate ratio, exact variant, serving text/value/unit, URL, private archive URI, and source SHA-256.
Fingerprint identity changes with amount, form, serving, or source evidence.
A planned mixture needs at least two unique form-and-ratio identities with one serving and source-recipe context.
Component masses remain separate and are never converted to or summed as pure L-citrulline.
implementation.coexistence_policy: A variant override may use singular citrulline or citrulline_components, but never both. The planner blocks an implicit transition and public presentation fails closed on coexistence or incomplete component evidence.
implementation.compatibility: Before the migration, existing product and structured-fact reads/review continue; component store/apply returns a specific migration-required error. After migration, the same panel, planner, apply, and public resolver support component rows while legacy singular facts remain unchanged.
implementation.private_evidence_exposure: Server-side evidence is used to prove applied facts; public output contains only the source kind and no archive URI, source hash, or reviewer data.

changes: Recreates the existing proposed-field, fact-shape, and proposed-unit CHECK constraints.
Every required CHECK expression remains wrapped with IS TRUE, including nullable predicates.
Adds no DML, table, column, grant, role, or public access.

isolated_postgresql.proof: Pre-migration rejection and legacy queue read, post-migration direct-SQL NULL/partial-row rejection, two-form readback, immutable reviewed evidence, duplicate-safe retry, and legacy product-path readback.

migration_selector.proof: Production ledger remains 207 applied migrations and exposes exactly the component migration as pending with the sealed normalized hash.

deployment_order_for_owner_decision: Review and publish the implementation commit; deploy the compatibility code while the production schema is still unchanged.
Smoke-read the authenticated nutrition panel and existing product/structured candidate queue; component writes must still report the migration-required error.

Run the controlled production selector read-only and require exactly 20260913110000_add_nutrition_candidate_citrulline_components.sql with normalized SHA-256 76dd8390e19f45dd8ffcc69bafe9721abc6dedff6db280fdc6f75e3938258ac4.
Record the production queue and relevant catalogue state, then apply only that migration through the existing controlled migration path.
Open a new connection and read back migration history plus all three CHECK definitions; confirm IS TRUE, the existing queue, authenticated panel sections, and unchanged catalogue data.
Only under a later data-write authorization, prepare and dry-run the 18 exact component candidates for the nine retained variants, then use the existing store, review, plan, and apply stages.
next_step: One owner decision may authorize publishing the code and executing the single sealed production migration in the order above; it does not authorize the later 18 candidate writes.
